description: This file defines the ApiList class, which manages a collection of API components including packages, classes, fields, and methods. It provides functionality for tracking warnings and errors, retrieving and creating package entries, and debugging information.

classes.name: ApiList
classes.description: Manages a list of API members, including packages and associated metadata such as warnings and errors.

methods.name: ApiList
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ApiList with a debug string.

methods.name: getDebugString
methods.description: Returns the debug string identifying this ApiList.

methods.name: getOrCreatePackage
methods.description: Retrieves a package by name, creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: getPackageIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all known packages.
